name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan Yojana (PM-KUSUM) - Uttarakhand
benefit:
Under the scheme, farmers receive an 80% subsidy on the cost of a solar pump set from the Government of India and the State Government, while the remaining 20% of the cost is borne by the farmer.

_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. As per the guidelines of MNRE, Government of India: - The farmer must agree to contribute 20% of the cost of the solar pump set as the farmer’s share. - The farmer must have his own borewell. - The farmer should currently be using a diesel pump set for irrigation. - A farmer who wishes to install a USPC along with the solar pump set must agree to make 100% payment for the said work.
